title: Arduino Powered LED
description: 5V Arduino USB powered circuit with 1kΩ current limiter and LED verification

steps.instruction: Place 1kΩ resistor between hole E10 and hole E14

hints.missing: Insert the 1kΩ resistor with leads spanning E10 to E14.
hints.wrong_position: Wrong row — move one lead to E10 and other to E14.
hints.occluded: Move your hands away, then press TEST.

steps.instruction: Insert LED: long leg (anode) in E14, short leg (cathode) in E18

hints.missing: Insert LED with longer lead (anode) sharing row E14 with resistor.
hints.reversed: Reverse the LED: long lead must connect to E14 (+5V side).
hints.wrong_position: Move the LED cathode (short lead) to row E18.

steps.instruction: Connect yellow jumper wire from Arduino Pin D7 to hole E10

hints.missing: Run the yellow wire from Arduino digital pin 7 into hole E10.
hints.wrong_position: Check connection: wire must enter hole E10 to power the resistor.

steps.instruction: Connect jumper wire from hole E18 to the negative ground rail (-)

hints.missing: Add a return path wire connecting E18 to the ground rail.
hints.wrong_position: Connect E18 directly to the ground (-) blue rail.

steps.instruction: Connect black wire from Arduino GND pin to breadboard ground rail (-)

hints.missing: Connect Arduino GND pin to breadboard (-) rail to complete circuit ground.
hints.safety_violation: Short circuit! Do not bridge 5V directly to ground.
